Nothing wrong with it of course - just finding it ironic :)

comments.author: Laurencio
comments.body: Stop giving false examples of namban trade profits! Yes, its possible to sell stuff with 99.9M profit, but... how much TIME was needed to get that goods!? Isnt just sailing to EA and back, you need to get the goods to exchange, to fill 40% of the ship (with preference)... so, you need more time to fill the rest. It takes time, AND fast goods in SEA arent 100% efficient and you are with 40% of the cargo hold occupied, so you could need 2 more barters... still adding time. And go back, and found a good selling price... isnt as easy as some people says!

comments.author: Nina
comments.body:
I'm sure there are better examples but here is what I find to work very well.. I have a Saint Lucia farm. I sail to the SA North Plateau and find the stacked boulder just west of the entrance.

i use procure (R8) and collect berries at very quickly. I after I'm at my limit, I run back to Saint Lucia and convert the berries to raisins.

Once done, I then convert to wine. Wine is the top Alcohol choice of Japan. Then I just wait for the next festival to cash in.

Give it a try, I'm sure their are better ideas, but it works for me and I've really leveled procurement doing this process.
